known_divergence: The sixth instance of stale operational state (PR #56, which applied items 2 and 3 against this repository's own recorded ordering) is closed: #57 reverted it, and the fixtures are byte-identical to the sealed set at e37fa3b. A seventh opened at 2026-09-04T06:46:45Z and is closed by this commit: the human decision was recorded on issue #52, and until now this file still read resume_decision WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY with a stop_reason naming the question that decision answers, while NS-031 - whose evidence requirement the decision had already met - remained the primary action. The interval was under four minutes because the decision record named the gap itself. That is not a fix for the underlying defect: state still reconciles by hand, and the proposal that would retire hand-maintenance remains PROPOSED on a failed instrument. WP-030 is stacked on WP-029's unmerged branch so that both can update this file without a merge conflict; if PR #58 merges with its branch deleted, GitHub retargets WP-030 to main. Until both merge, main's copy of this file still names WP-029 - that is the ordinary lag of a stacked change, not an eighth instance, because the record here says so. WP-030 merged as PR #64 after its stacked PR #60 was closed by the deletion of its base branch; the stacking rationale in DEC-028 (7) was wrong and is corrected by DEC-029 and this note - stack nothing on a branch that will be deleted. WP-031 merged as PR #65 at 28898879bef6 and the site serves that head; the README paragraph that said Pages was blocked and the site returned 404 outlived the deployment by more than a day, and is replaced under WP-032 by pointers rather than by a fresher sentence - a fresher sentence would be the eighth instance waiting to happen.
